name: /help explains the bot in plain language

payload.text:
ℹ️ How to use this bot:

Just type your question in the chat — I'll answer it right away!

Example prompts:
• What's the capital of France?
• How do I reset my password?
• Explain quantum computing simply

Use the buttons to:
• Mark answers as helpful or not
• Report issues for admin review
• Adjust your answer preferences

Commands:
• /start — Open the main menu
• /help — Show this message
